tasks.title: Fix pricing.ts applyDiscount
tasks.brief:
Project: /tmp/v3orch/w/t2 (node, TypeScript files run with node --test; `npm test` runs test/*.test.ts). Three tests fail, each with exactly one bug in its own src file. YOUR FILE: src/pricing.ts ONLY. Do not edit any test or any other file.

Bug: applyDiscount(cents, pct) is documented as `pct is a whole percentage: applyDiscount(1000, 10) === 900`, but the code is `return Math.round(cents * (1 - pct));`, so pct is never divided by 100. Fix: `return Math.round(cents * (1 - pct / 100));`. Keep everything else in the file unchanged (subtotal, tax).

When done, run `npm test` only to confirm the pricing tests pass, and report in 2 lines what you changed and the pricing test result. Other files may still fail; that is expected.

tasks.brief:
Project: /tmp/v3orch/w/t2 (node, TypeScript files run with node --test; `npm test` runs test/*.test.ts). Three tests fail, each with exactly one bug in its own src file. YOUR FILE: src/checkout.ts ONLY. Do not edit any test or any other file.
